takeaways.en: Column quality shows the share of valid, error and empty values; Column distribution shows distinct and unique counts.
takeaways.zh: 「列质量」显示有效、错误和空值的比例；「列分布」显示非重复值和唯一值的数量。

takeaways.en: Column profile adds statistics (min, max, average, count, nulls) and a value distribution for one column.
takeaways.zh: 「列配置文件」为单列提供统计数据（最小值、最大值、平均值、计数、空值）和值分布。

takeaways.en: By default profiling looks at the top 1,000 rows; switch to the entire data set in the status bar.
takeaways.zh: 默认只分析前 1,000 行；可在状态栏切换为整个数据集。

html.en: Before cleaning data you need to know what is wrong with it. The Power Query Editor's View ribbon has three profiling tools.
html.zh: 清理数据前，先要知道数据哪里有问题。Power Query 编辑器的视图功能区有三个数据分析工具。

rows.zh: 列质量

rows.en: % Valid, % Error, % Empty under each header
rows.zh: 每个列标题下的有效、错误、空值百分比

rows.en: Errors from type conversion, missing values
rows.zh: 类型转换错误、缺失值
列分布

rows.en: A small histogram, distinct count and unique count
rows.zh: 小直方图、非重复值数量和唯一值数量

rows.en: Whether a column can be a key (distinct = unique = rows)
rows.zh: 某列能否当键（非重复 = 唯一 = 行数）
列配置文件

rows.en: Count, error, empty, distinct, unique, min, max, average, standard deviation, value distribution
rows.zh: 计数、错误、空值、非重复、唯一、最小、最大、平均、标准差、值分布
离群值、意外值、偏斜数据

html.en: The status bar says Column profiling based on top 1000 rows. Click it and choose entire data set, otherwise problems further down the table stay hidden.
html.zh: 状态栏显示基于前 1000 行的列分析。点它并选择整个数据集，否则表格后面的问题会被漏掉。

html.en: Distinct counts how many different values appear; unique counts values that appear exactly once. A column that will be the key of a dimension table must have distinct = unique = the number of rows, and no empty values.
html.zh: 非重复值（distinct）是出现过多少种不同的值；唯一值（unique）是只出现一次的值有多少个。要当作维度表键的列，必须满足非重复值 = 唯一值 = 行数，而且没有空值。

q.en: Column quality shows 100% valid, but you suspect bad values near the end of a 2-million-row table. What should you check first?
q.zh: 「列质量」显示 100% 有效，但你怀疑一张 200 万行的表在后段有错误值。首先该检查什么？

html.en: Switch profiling to the entire data set
html.zh: 把列分析切换为整个数据集

why.en: Right: by default only the top 1,000 rows are profiled.
why.zh: 对：默认只分析前 1,000 行。

html.en: Change the data type to Text

why.en: That hides errors rather than finding them.
why.zh: 那只会掩盖错误，而不是找出错误。

html.en: Refresh the report in the service

why.en: Profiling happens in the Power Query Editor.
why.zh: 数据分析是在 Power Query 编辑器中进行的。

html.en: Turn on Column distribution

why.en: It still uses the same 1,000-row sample.
why.zh: 它仍然只用那 1,000 行样本。

q.en: Which profile result tells you a CustomerID column can serve as the key of the Customer table?
q.zh: 哪种分析结果说明 CustomerID 列可以作为 Customer 表的键？

html.en: A normal-looking distribution

why.en: The shape says nothing about duplicates.
why.zh: 分布形状说明不了是否重复。

html.en: Distinct count higher than unique count

why.en: That means some values repeat.
why.zh: 这表示有些值重复出现。

html.en: Distinct count = unique count = row count, no empty values
html.zh: 非重复值 = 唯一值 = 行数，且没有空值

why.en: Right: every row has its own non-blank value.
why.zh: 对：每一行都有自己的、非空的值。

html.en: 100% valid

why.en: Valid values can still repeat.
why.zh: 有效的值仍可能重复。

heading.en: Fixing inconsistent, null and unexpected values
heading.zh: 修正不一致、空值和意外值

takeaways.en: Replace values, Trim, Clean and Format (case) fix inconsistent text such as "NY", "ny " and "New York".
takeaways.zh: 「替换值」「修整」「清除」和「格式」（大小写）可以修正不一致的文字，例如「NY」「ny 」和「New York」。

takeaways.en: Fill down/up copies a value into the blank cells below or above it, common after reading report-style Excel files.
takeaways.zh: 「向下/向上填充」把值复制到下方或上方的空白单元格，常用于读取报表格式的 Excel 文件之后。

takeaways.en: Remove duplicates and filter out unwanted rows before the table is used as a dimension.
takeaways.zh: 表作为维度表之前，要先删除重复项并筛掉不需要的行。

html.en: Data quality problems come in a few familiar shapes. Power Query has a button for each, and every click becomes an applied step you can review, reorder or delete.
html.zh: 数据质量问题有几种常见形态。Power Query 为每一种都准备了按钮，每次点击都会变成可以检查、重新排序或删除的应用的步骤。

rows.zh: 前后空格、不可打印字符
转换 → 格式 → 修整 / 清除
大小写混用：「north」「NORTH」

rows.en: Format → Capitalize Each Word, UPPERCASE or lowercase
rows.zh: 格式 → 每个字词首字母大写、大写或小写
拼写不同：「NY」「New York」

rows.en: Replace Values, or a mapping table merged in
rows.zh: 替换值，或合并一张对照表

rows.en: Blank cells under a group heading
rows.zh: 分组标题下方的空白单元格
填充 → 向下（或向上）
本应是 0 的地方为 null

rows.en: Replace Values: null → 0 (only if 0 is really correct)
rows.zh: 替换值：null → 0（只在 0 确实正确时）
重复的行或键
选取键列 → 删除重复项

rows.en: Rows that are not data (totals, notes)
rows.zh: 不是数据的行（合计、备注）
删除行（前几行、后几行、空行）或筛选
超出有效范围的值

rows.en: Filter rows, or a conditional column that flags them
rows.zh: 筛选行，或用条件列标记出来

html.en: Remove Duplicates in Power Query is case-sensitive: "abc" and "ABC" stay as two rows, but the model's engine treats them as the same value. Fix the case first, or a relationship can fail with a duplicate-key error.
html.zh: Power Query 的「删除重复项」区分大小写：「abc」和「ABC」会保留为两行，但模型引擎会把它们视为同一个值。要先统一大小写，否则建立关系时可能出现键重复的错误。

html.en: Think before replacing nulls. A missing sales amount is not the same as zero sales; averages and counts change if you invent values. Often the right fix is in the source system, with Power Query only flagging the problem.
html.zh: 替换 null 之前要想清楚。缺少销售金额并不等于销售为零；如果凭空填值，平均数和计数都会改变。很多时候正确的做法是在源系统中修正，而 Power Query 只负责把问题标出来。

q.en: A product dimension has "widget" and "Widget" as two rows. The relationship to Sales fails because the key is not unique. What do you do?
q.zh: 某产品维度表有「widget」和「Widget」两行。由于键不唯一，与 Sales 的关系建立失败。应该怎么做？

html.en: Remove Duplicates only

why.en: Both rows survive because they differ by case.
why.zh: 两行都会保留，因为它们大小写不同。

html.en: Standardise the case, then Remove Duplicates
html.zh: 先统一大小写，再删除重复项

why.en: Right: Power Query's duplicate check is case-sensitive, the model's is not.
why.zh: 对：Power Query 的重复检查区分大小写，模型则不区分。

html.en: Trim the column

why.en: Trim removes spaces, not case differences.
why.zh: 修整只去掉空格，不处理大小写差异。

html.en: Change the relationship to many-to-many

why.en: That hides a data quality problem and makes the model harder to use.
why.zh: 那会掩盖数据质量问题，也让模型更难用。

q.en: An Excel export shows the region name only on the first row of each block, with blanks below. Which transformation fills them in?
q.zh: 某 Excel 导出文件只在每组的第一行显示区域名称，下方都是空白。用哪个转换来补上？

html.en: Fill Down

why.en: Right: it copies each value into the empty cells beneath it.
why.zh: 对：会把每个值复制到下方的空白单元格。

html.en: Unpivot
Replace Errors

why.en: The cells are empty, not errors.
why.zh: 那些单元格是空的，不是错误。

html.en: Transpose

takeaways.en: Cell-level errors (DataFormat.Error) usually come from a type conversion; replace, remove or fix them at the source.
takeaways.zh: 单元格级错误（DataFormat.Error）通常来自类型转换；可以替换、删除或在源头修正。

takeaways.en: Step-level errors stop the whole query: a missing file, a renamed column, expired credentials or a privacy firewall.
takeaways.zh: 步骤级错误会让整个查询停止：文件不见了、列被改名、凭据过期或隐私防火墙。

takeaways.en: Keep Errors creates a view of only the failing rows, which helps you find the cause.
takeaways.zh: 「保留错误」会产生只含出错行的视图，有助于找出原因。

html.en: Errors in Power Query are either in a cell (the query still runs, but some values are errors) or in a step (the whole query fails). They need different fixes.
html.zh: Power Query 中的错误，要么在单元格（查询仍能运行，但部分值是错误），要么在步骤（整个查询失败）。两者的修正方法不同。

rows.zh: 单元格中的 DataFormat.Error

rows.en: Text like "N/A" in a column changed to a number or date
rows.zh: 被改成数字或日期的列里有「N/A」之类的文字

rows.en: Replace Errors, Remove Errors, or clean the text before Changed Type
rows.zh: 替换错误、删除错误，或在「更改的类型」之前先清理文字
日期解析错误（03/04 → 4 月 3 日）

rows.en: Source uses a different regional format
rows.zh: 源数据使用不同的区域格式
更改类型 → 使用区域设置
Expression.Error：找不到列

rows.en: Source column renamed or removed; a step refers to the old name
rows.zh: 源列被改名或删除；某步骤仍引用旧名称

rows.en: Edit the step (often Changed Type) or rename back
rows.zh: 编辑该步骤（通常是「更改的类型」）或改回原名
DataSource.Error：找不到文件
文件被移动或改名
数据源设置 → 更改源
凭据错误

rows.en: Password changed or OAuth token expired
rows.zh: 密码更改或 OAuth 令牌过期

rows.en: Edit credentials in Desktop or the semantic model settings
rows.zh: 在 Desktop 或语义模型设置中编辑凭据
Formula.Firewall

rows.en: Sources with incompatible privacy levels combined
rows.zh: 合并了隐私级别不兼容的来源

rows.en: Set correct privacy levels, or restructure queries
rows.zh: 设定正确的隐私级别，或调整查询结构

html.en: To investigate cell errors, right-click the column and choose Keep Errors in a duplicate of the query: you see only the failing rows and can click a cell to read the error message.
html.zh: 要调查单元格错误，可以在查询的副本中右键单击该列，选择保留错误：只会看到出错的行，点单元格即可读取错误信息。

html.en: "Using Locale" is the answer whenever a scenario mentions dates or decimals from another country's format (day/month vs month/day, comma as decimal separator).
html.zh: 只要题目提到来自其他国家格式的日期或小数（日/月与月/日、逗号作为小数点），答案就是「使用区域设置」。

q.en: A CSV from a European office has dates like 03/04/2026 meaning 3 April, but Power BI reads them as 4 March. What do you do?
q.zh: 欧洲办公室的 CSV 中，日期 03/04/2026 表示 4 月 3 日，但 Power BI 读成 3 月 4 日。该怎么做？

html.en: Replace Errors

why.en: There are no errors; the dates are wrong silently.
why.zh: 这里没有错误；日期是悄悄地被读错了。

html.en: Format the column in the Data view
html.zh: 在数据视图中设置列格式

why.en: Formatting cannot fix a wrongly parsed date.
why.zh: 格式无法修正已被读错的日期。

html.en: Change Type → Using Locale, with the source's locale
html.zh: 更改类型 → 使用区域设置，选择源数据的区域

why.en: Right: the locale tells Power Query how to read the text.
why.zh: 对：区域设置告诉 Power Query 该如何读取文字。

html.en: Change the report's language

why.en: That changes display, not parsing.
why.zh: 那只改变显示，不改变解析方式。

q.en: After someone renamed a column in the source Excel file, refresh fails with "The column 'Qty' of the table wasn't found". Where is the problem?
q.zh: 有人在源 Excel 文件中把某列改名后，刷新失败，显示「找不到表的列 'Qty'」。问题出在哪里？

html.en: A DAX measure

why.en: The error comes from Power Query before DAX runs.
why.zh: 这个错误来自 Power Query，发生在 DAX 执行之前。

html.en: The gateway
A step (often Changed Type) still refers to the old column name
html.zh: 某个步骤（通常是「更改的类型」）仍引用旧列名

why.en: Right: edit that step or rename the column back.
why.zh: 对：编辑那个步骤，或把列名改回去。

html.en: The privacy level
